description: Store an encrypted platform credential in the UnClick Keychain. Tests the credential against the platform API before saving. Scoped to the caller's UNCLICK_API_KEY.

credential.description: API key or token for the platform.

label.description: Optional label to distinguish multiple credentials for the same platform (default: 'default').

platform.description: Platform ID: github, supabase, vercel, stripe, cloudflare.

name: keychain_connect
